title: SEKA Exceed RDC First Impressions

takeaways.text: The RDC layup is described as about 180 g lighter than the standard Exceed in a medium; he thinks it likely shares a factory with Factor.
Weighed: medium frame 885 g and bars 350 g; the complete Force AXS build with Vortex 60 mm wheels came in just under 7.5 kg with power-meter pedals.
Frameset with bars cost A$3,230 in 2021, about US$600 more than a Winspace T1500 with integrated bar.
The medium runs slightly small with a 535 mm effective top tube and moderate race geometry; 30 mm tires should fit, though he runs 25 mm.

disclosure: The frameset and wheels were provided by retailer Cycling 100, which sponsored several videos. The frame is the Exceed RDC; the candidate dealer build does not state whether it uses the RDC or standard Exceed frame.
summary: First impressions of a medium SEKA Exceed RDC built with SRAM Force AXS, including weights and an ultrasound check.
